# Crystal Heart

Internal ID: TrinketSilverResist | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Silver x5, Crystal x5, Stone Golem trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 80 | Effect: Slightly resistant (25%) VS Blunt | Slightly resistant (25%) VS Slash | Slightly resistant (25%) VS Pierce | Duration: 50s

# Introduction

Crystal Heart is a Mountain-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 80 Adrenaline has been gained, the Crystal Heart will trigger automatically, providing a slight resistance (25%) to all physical damage (Blunt, Slash, and Pierce) for 50 seconds.
Crystal Heart's effect does not stack with Bonemass' forsaken power.

Categorias: Trinket
